# App and interface icons

Interface and social/integration icons use `@hugeicons/react` and `@hugeicons/core-free-icons`.
Official integration documentation: https://hugeicons.com/docs/integrations/react/quick-start
Package license files are shipped in `node_modules/@hugeicons/react/LICENSE.md` and `node_modules/@hugeicons/core-free-icons/LICENSE.md`.

The supplied custom status SVG remains unchanged.
